name: create_event
description: Add an event to the calendar. Copy the date and time words exactly as the user said them.

title.description: The event title as the user said it.

when.description: The date and time phrase exactly as spoken, for example tomorrow at 7 or Friday at noon.

duration_minutes.description: Length of the event in minutes.

name: list_events
description: List what is on the calendar for a day.

day.description: The day the user asked about, copied exactly as said, for example today or next Monday.

name: cancel_event
description: Remove an event from the calendar by its title.

title.description: The title of the event to remove, as the user said it.
